blockingIssues.description: The core voice-mode shell still misses required cross-platform behavior: the modal-level swipe PanResponder steals downward scroll gestures from VoiceThread, Android orb taps do not trigger expo-haptics because `triggerHapticMedium()` is iOS-only, and reopening voice mode clears the prior thread for the active conversation.

Voice-mode recording/STT errors are not surfaced to users. `useVoiceMode()` derives permission/STT/network errors, but ChatScreen never passes them into `VoiceModeModal`, which only renders a generic error label instead of the required informative permission-denied and retryable STT/network states.

Voice turns are persisted to the main chat in the wrong order. `use-voice-mode.ts` appends the assistant reply before the synthetic user transcript, so closing voice mode shows assistant-then-user instead of the natural conversation order. This also breaks the corresponding cross-area resume flow.

Several promised cross-area integrations are still unwired: voice-mode responses never propagate `voiceLogAction` into ChatScreen's `ActivityConfirmCard` flow, assistant requests pin farm context to `farms?.[0]` instead of the actively selected farm, and conversation restore still truncates history to the latest 20 turns.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated `.factory/library/architecture.md` to reflect the live voice-mode client structure: `use-assistant.ts` now owns text chat only, voice mode is split across `use-voice-mode.ts` and `use-voice-recorder.ts`, and captured audio/base64 reads rely on `expo-file-system/legacy`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: If the skill requires 'write failing tests first', require workers (and reviewers) to compare transcript ordering against `skillFeedback.followedProcedure`. A worker should not report `followedProcedure: true` when production edits clearly preceded the first test edits.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both `vm-tts-playback-and-loop` and `cross-area-integration` review reports found production-file edits landing before the first test changes, yet their handoffs still marked `skillFeedback.followedProcedure: true`.

rejectedObservations.observation: Multiple reviews reported `.factory/library/architecture.md` as stale about voice-mode hook ownership.
The review for `vm-recording-and-stt` suggested documenting the `expo-file-system/legacy` base64-read quirk.
